descriptionByLocale.it:
As an Senior Specialist in the Portfolio Management Oversight team, you will support the Management Company in a variety of activities that could include, but are not limited to:
• Assisting with the management and review of the Fund Contracts, Asset Manager Delegation Agreements
• Supporting the monitoring of investment restrictions
• Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders across different jurisdictions
• Contributing to regulatory and compliance projects
• Participating in the ongoing improvement of oversight processes
• Overseeing and monitoring Portfolio Managers and their related activities (i.e. Due Diligence process)
• Assisting with the implementation of regulatory changes and new business initiatives
